violations.text: Various foods were observed held above 46 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Lunch was ending. Per PIC all food is thrown out end of day. Unit to no longer be used until able to hold food at adequate temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
The cold rail was observed in poor repair. Unit to no longer be used until it can hold food at 41 degrees or less. Unit was observed at 51-56 degrees. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

The floor next to the chip closet and underneath the shelving in the warewashing area has an accumulation of rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

The ceiling in the kitchen and ware wash area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Approved finish material sheet previously provided. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Sink and surface sanitizer solution was in excess of 1875 parts per million (ppm). A sink and surface solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label.
